scene: You zip down the sparkling wire onto a busy transit platform.
picture: Side-scrolling view of an open-air junction platform. The player in her red bomber jacket and roller skates lands at left-centre from an overhead wire. Far left sits a steaming noodle-bowl monorail car. Centre hangs a woven bamboo cable car. Far right floats a giant red paper-lantern hot-air balloon, tethered and waiting.
shown: a steaming noodle-bowl shaped monorail car idling at the far left platform
a green bamboo cable car suspended from a cable at centre
a giant glowing red paper-lantern balloon basket moored at the far right
